artifact_policy: ONE current calibration per subject, regenerated in place (atomic tmp+rename). No version chain (K2).
assumptions: event return ~ Normal(0, sigma_event) with sigma_event = max(implied as 1 sigma, implied as E|move|) from the optionslam weekly quote
hit = 0.5 is the null convention (P(non-positive) = 50%), not an edge claim
the optionslam weekly window (to Oct 16) is wider than the Oct 13 event - using it unchanged overstates sigma_event slightly, which is the conservative direction for K8
band is set AT the quoted implied move (5.64%), matching the TSLA/MU/UNH convention

calibration.note: JPM's event sigma (~7.07%) is ~6.2x its realised daily sigma - an earnings bet must be banded against the event quote, not the daily sigma; the daily sigmas are context only
calibration.realised_source: stockanalysis.com/stocks/jpm/history -- S&P Global Market Intelligence, Close column, page 'Last checked: Sep 23, 2026' (read after the 16:00 EDT close, final prints; raw Close == Adj. Close on every row - JPM pays a quarterly dividend but the columns agree in this window as printed)
calibration.sigma_event_basis: max(implied as 1 sigma, implied as E|move|) - the conservative leg

sigma_legs.implied_source: optionslam.com/earnings/straddle/JPM: 'Implied Move Weekly: 5.64% Expires on: Oct. 16, 2026', observed 2026-09-24 - the weekly window (to Oct 16) is the nearest-dated quote covering the 2026-10-13 print; using it unchanged is the conservative direction (window longer than the event)

K6: entry quote within 1 trading day of the run
pricing source is fresh quotes, not the corrupt ledger series
